comment:
* A drawable that can draw a "Drawer hamburger" menu or an arrow and animate between them. *

* The progress between the two states is controlled via {@link #setProgress(float)}. *

variables.name: ARROW_DIRECTION_LEFT
variables.comment:
* Direction to make the arrow point towards the left.
     *
     * @see #setDirection(int)
     * @see #getDirection()

variables.name: ARROW_DIRECTION_RIGHT
variables.comment:
* Direction to make the arrow point towards the right.
     *
     * @see #setDirection(int)
     * @see #getDirection()

variables.name: ARROW_DIRECTION_START
variables.comment:
* Direction to make the arrow point towards the start. * *

When used in a view with a {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL RTL} layout direction, * this is the same as {@link #ARROW_DIRECTION_RIGHT}, otherwise it is the same as * {@link #ARROW_DIRECTION_LEFT}.

* * @see #setDirection(int) * @see #getDirection()

variables.name: ARROW_DIRECTION_END
variables.comment:
* Direction to make the arrow point to the end. * *

When used in a view with a {@link ViewCompat#LAYOUT_DIRECTION_RTL RTL} layout direction, * this is the same as {@link #ARROW_DIRECTION_LEFT}, otherwise it is the same as * {@link #ARROW_DIRECTION_RIGHT}.

* * @see #setDirection(int) * @see #getDirection()

variables.name: ARROW_HEAD_ANGLE
variables.comment: The angle in degrees that the arrow head is inclined at.

variables.name: mArrowHeadLength
variables.comment: The length of top and bottom bars when they merge into an arrow

variables.name: mArrowShaftLength
variables.comment: The length of the middle bar when arrow is shaped

variables.name: mBarGap
variables.comment: The space between bars when they are parallel

variables.name: mSpin
variables.comment: Whether bars should spin or not during progress

variables.name: mSize
variables.comment: The reported intrinsic size of the drawable.

variables.name: mVerticalMirror
variables.comment: Whether we should mirror animation when animation is reversed.

variables.name: mProgress
variables.comment: The interpolated version of the original progress

variables.name: mMaxCutForBarSize
variables.comment: the amount that overlaps w/ bar size when rotation is max

methods.name: public void setArrowHeadLength(float length)
methods.comment:
* Sets the length of the arrow head (from tip to edge, perpendicular to the shaft).
     *
     * @param length the length in pixels

methods.name: public float getArrowHeadLength()
methods.comment:
* Returns the length of the arrow head (from tip to edge, perpendicular to the shaft),
     * in pixels.

methods.name: public void setArrowShaftLength(float length)
methods.comment:
* Sets the arrow shaft length.
     *
     * @param length the length in pixels

methods.name: public float getArrowShaftLength()
methods.comment: * Returns the arrow shaft length in pixels.

methods.name: public float getBarLength()
methods.comment: * The length of the bars when they are parallel to each other.

methods.name: public void setBarLength(float length)
methods.comment:
* Sets the length of the bars when they are parallel to each other.
     *
     * @param length the length in pixels

methods.name: public void setColor(@ColorInt int color)
methods.comment: * Sets the color of the drawable.

methods.name: public int getColor()
methods.comment: * Returns the color of the drawable.

methods.name: public void setBarThickness(float width)
methods.comment:
* Sets the thickness (stroke size) for the bars.
     *
     * @param width stroke width in pixels

methods.name: public float getBarThickness()
methods.comment: * Returns the thickness (stroke width) of the bars.

methods.name: public float getGapSize()
methods.comment:
* Returns the max gap between the bars when they are parallel to each other.
     *
     * @see #getGapSize()

methods.name: public void setGapSize(float gap)
methods.comment:
* Sets the max gap between the bars when they are parallel to each other.
     *
     * @param gap the gap in pixels
     *
     * @see #getGapSize()

methods.name: public void setDirection(@ArrowDirection int direction)
methods.comment: * Set the arrow direction.

methods.name: public boolean isSpinEnabled()
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the bars should rotate or not during the transition.
     *
     * @see #setSpinEnabled(boolean)

methods.name: public void setSpinEnabled(boolean enabled)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the bars should rotate or not during the transition.
     *
     * @param enabled true if the bars should rotate.
     *
     * @see #isSpinEnabled()

methods.name: public int getDirection()
methods.comment: * Returns the arrow direction.

methods.name: public void setVerticalMirror(boolean verticalMirror)
methods.comment: * If set, canvas is flipped when progress reached to end and going back to start.

methods.name: public float getProgress()
methods.comment: * Returns the current progress of the arrow.

methods.name: public void setProgress(@FloatRange(from = 0.0, to = 1.0) float progress)
methods.comment:
* Set the progress of the arrow. * *

A value of {@code 0.0} indicates that the arrow should be drawn in its starting * position. A value of {@code 1.0} indicates that the arrow should be drawn in its ending * position.

methods.name: public final Paint getPaint()
methods.comment: * Returns the paint instance used for all drawing.

methods.comment: * Linear interpolate between a and b with parameter t.
